summary: Iteration 14 — GSTIN offline lookup + auto-fill tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed for GET /api/gstin/lookup (valid AP GSTIN, TG, Delhi, bad, missing, empty, lowercase+spaces, note field, auth-required). Frontend: New Customer modal on /customers auto-fills State='Andhra Pradesh' + PAN='AAECR5210P' + toast 'GSTIN valid · Andhra Pradesh' on typing 37AAECR5210P2Z2. Invalid GSTIN input shows 'Invalid GSTIN format' toast. New Party modal on /parties auto-fills State='Delhi' + PAN='AABCU9603R' on typing 07AABCU9603R1ZM (checksum warn toast fires as expected for that synthetic GSTIN). Auth regression: Bearer test_session_bitumen_2026 works across all APIs.
critical_code_review_comments: Customers.jsx: the GSTIN onChange handler is async but calls setForm(next) AFTER an awaited network call — if the user types more chars while the request is in flight, the stale `next` (based on old `form`) will overwrite newer state (typical React stale-closure bug). Consider using the functional setForm updater or aborting on newer input. Not user-visible for this feature (maxLength=15) but worth noting.
Parties.jsx presumably shares the same pattern — verify the same functional-updater fix is applied there.
Empty-string GSTIN query returns 400 but a missing query param returns FastAPI's 422 (default). Consider making `gstin: Optional[str] = None` and returning a uniform 400 for both cases.
GSTIN_LOOKUP_API_KEY placeholder is well-structured; when integrating paid provider, ensure timeouts + graceful fallback to offline parse on provider errors.
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_bitumen_2026 (user_id=test-user-bitumen). Backend /api/auth/me returns 200 with this token.
seed_data_creation: No persisted data — modal forms were only opened, not saved. Cleanup script ran but found nothing to delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GSTIN feature is stable. Backend endpoint at /api/gstin/lookup (auth required). Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_gstin_lookup.py — 9 tests, all passing. Frontend integrated in Customers.jsx (data-testid customer-input-gstin) and Parties.jsx (data-testid party-input-gstin). Auto-fill fires only when input length reaches 15.
